🐛 Return min and max by value so lazy chains do not dangle

parrot::min and parrot::max declared their result as
decltype(a < b ? a : b), which is const T&. In a lazy chain such as
arr.max(20).min(other), the reference points at a value that is gone by
the time the next stage reads it. The existing CombinedArrayAndScalarTest
expected {20, 15, 40, 30} for that chain; min(max(35, 20), 40) is 35, so
the test passed only because it matched the dangling read. Return T,
correct the expectation, and add a test that also checks that neither
functor returns a reference.
